sources.title: Japan's Takaichi backs Quad in first call to Modi amid US silence
Quad summit in India unlikely despite Trump's claim of PM invite

stances_toward.note: Takaichi reaffirmed Japan's backing for the Quad in her first call with Modi (late Oct 2025) while Washington stayed silent; the leaders' summit in India, promised for 2025 and then for the first quarter of 2026, has not been held or dated. Japan is steady, the grouping is stalled - hence cooling. Our reading (C). Bond - affinity.
